provenance.projection: Serialized SDK records project parentGroupId from parent.id before calling the existing exporter normalizeTokens. Legacy color byte alpha is divided by 255, with legacy hex omitted from normalized input so rgba retains opacity; typography font.family/subfamily project to fontFamily/fontWeight. Original values are preserved alongside normalized tokens.
provenance.mismatch: Selected Figma scenes and this Supernova snapshot have unresolved token aliases. Per-scene font inventories and source typography values are recorded; reference typography includes both Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans. Authored token use is a semantic palette adaptation, not verified exact Figma token binding.
